usedFor: Teams watch Confluence Cloud for new content with “New Page or BlogPost” and pass each item on.

bestTemplate.name: “New Page or BlogPost” in Confluence Cloud, then “Upload File to Dropbox” in Dropbox
bestTemplate.why: Each new page or blog post can start a file upload, so a copy is kept elsewhere.

watchOut: “New Page or BlogPost” is polling, so new pages are noticed on a schedule, not instantly.
